description: Avadh Girls’ Degree College is a higher education institution for female students in Lucknow, run by the Avadh Educational Society. The official history page states that it was founded in 1958 as Loreto Degree College and taken over by the society in 1975.

agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 government listing contains the exact institution name with Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate chain error; after confirming the expected official, government, and search hostnames, public GET requests used curl --insecure.
The official site provides a current regular/short-course catalogue for B.A., B.Com., four M.A. specializations, and the computer fundamentals certificate.

The official IGNOU Study Center page states 7 certificate, 6 diploma, and 7 degree courses but does not enumerate current programme names; its listed examples are historical 2021-2022 enrollment codes, so those programmes were not guessed or imported.
Programme durations were not explicitly stated on the reviewed official catalogue pages and were left null.
